tagline: Free, focused tools for independent professionals
description: Practical browser-based tools for independent contractors, landlords, photographers, and freelancers. No account required for the free core tools.

tools.name: PunchLite
tools.headline: Free Contractor Punch List Maker with Photos
tools.description: Create a jobsite punch list with photos, due dates, trade assignments and an exportable report. Works in your browser without an account.
tools.best_for: Contractors who need a simple jobsite issue tracker instead of an all-in-one construction platform.
howto: Name the project and create an item for each unfinished or defective task.
Assign each item to a trade, add a due date and photo, and mark it complete when resolved.
Export a CSV to preserve the task list or use Print to save a PDF summary.
tools.limitations: Records are stored on this device. There is no team collaboration, shared project history or cloud backup; photos may exhaust browser storage.
tools.faq_question: Does this punch list tool work without a login?
tools.faq_answer: Yes. PunchLite works in your browser. Save exports regularly because clearing browser storage can erase your work.

tools.name: MoveOutPDF
tools.headline: Free Move-Out Inspection Photo Report Maker
tools.description: Organize rental move-out photos by room, add notes and print an inspection photo report as a PDF directly from your browser.
tools.best_for: Independent landlords who want a clear, portable photo record at tenant handover.
howto: Set the property or project name and add move-out photos from your device.
Assign each photo to a room and write factual condition notes.
Use the print view to save a PDF; back up the report before closing the browser.
tools.limitations: This is a documentation aid, not a legal determination of damage or deposit deductions. No cloud storage or guaranteed evidence preservation is provided.
tools.faq_question: Can I generate a move-out report without uploading photos to a server?
tools.faq_answer: Yes. The MVP processes the selected photos in your browser. Export the report before leaving the page, as records may not persist.

tools.name: ShotGrid
tools.headline: Simple Product Photography Shot List Checklist
tools.description: Plan product photography shots, track shooting progress, bulk-import a checklist and export your shot list to CSV.
tools.best_for: Solo product photographers documenting angles, scenes and deliverables for repeatable shoots.
howto: Define shots by product, angle or setup.
Use bulk entry to plan a full shooting session quickly.
Check off completed images and export your list for handoff.
tools.limitations: A lightweight checklist, not a studio production scheduling platform or file delivery service.
tools.faq_question: Can I export a product photography shot list?
tools.faq_answer: Yes. Your checklist can be exported to CSV for spreadsheet review and client handoff.

tools.name: GentleNudge
tools.headline: Polite Overdue Invoice Reminder Email Generator
tools.description: Track overdue invoices, calculate payment lateness and copy a professional follow-up email without sending automatic messages.
tools.best_for: Freelancers who want friendly payment follow-ups but do not need accounting software.
howto: Enter the client, invoice amount and payment due date.
Review invoice age and choose a polite reminder draft.
Copy the email and send it yourself after checking details.
tools.limitations: No email is sent by the app. The tool is not a bookkeeping, tax or collections service.
tools.faq_question: Does this invoice reminder tool send emails for me?
tools.faq_answer: No. GentleNudge creates a draft you can review and copy. Email sending and payment collection remain in your control.

tools.name: NotaryMiles
tools.headline: Manual Mobile Notary Mileage Log and CSV Export
tools.description: Record business odometer readings, estimate trip distance and export a simple mileage log for independent notaries.
tools.best_for: Mobile notaries who prefer manual trip entry instead of continuous location tracking.
howto: Enter each trip date, destination and odometer start and end readings.
Review the calculated distance and optional reference-rate estimate.
Export a CSV and independently verify records before using for tax purposes.
tools.limitations: No GPS tracking or automatic trip detection. Mileage deductions and eligibility depend on the applicable tax rules and use case.
tools.faq_question: Does this mileage tool automatically detect trips?
tools.faq_answer: No. This is a manual odometer log. If you need automatic detection, select a dedicated GPS mileage app.

tools.name: ChangeOrderPad
tools.headline: Free Construction Change Order Calculator & Printable Form
tools.description: Estimate additional construction work from labor, materials, overhead and target margin, with a print-ready scope request.
tools.best_for: Small contractors pricing homeowner-requested scope changes before starting additional work.
howto: Enter the changed scope, labor hours and costs.
Set overhead and gross-margin assumptions and calculate the additional quote.
Print the change request for separate written approval; export the estimate CSV.
tools.limitations: Does not collect signatures or verify contract terms, taxes or permits. Sample values are not market rates.
tools.faq_question: Can this create a legally signed change order?
tools.faq_answer: No. It produces an estimate draft. Obtain client authorization using your actual contract process.

tools.name: DepositLedger
tools.headline: Free Security Deposit Deduction Ledger & Refund Calculator
tools.description: Itemize proposed deposit deductions with receipt references and calculate a draft refund, printable or exportable as CSV.
tools.best_for: Self-managing landlords organizing receipt-backed proposed charges and deposit accounting.
howto: Enter the deposit and any interest you independently determine is owed.
Add factual descriptions, amounts and invoice references for each proposed charge.
Review the refund math, export the ledger and verify local legal rules before sending.
tools.limitations: Not a legal notice; does not determine lawful deductions, deadlines, interest or ordinary wear and tear.
tools.faq_question: Does this check my state security-deposit laws?
tools.faq_answer: No. State and local rules vary. This worksheet performs arithmetic and produces a draft only.

tools.name: LicenseScope
tools.headline: Free Photography Usage License Scope & Quote Builder
tools.description: Draft commercial image usage terms and an illustrative quote by media, territory, term and exclusivity using your own base fee.
tools.best_for: Commercial photographers documenting proposed usage rights separately from their shooting fee.
howto: Enter the number of images and your own base licensing fee.
Select proposed media, territory, term and exclusivity; edit permitted channels.
Review the illustrative quote and copy or print the scope for contract review.
tools.limitations: Illustrative multipliers are not industry pricing standards. This is not a license, rights clearance or legal agreement.
tools.faq_question: Does this provide legally binding image licenses?
tools.faq_answer: No. It prepares a negotiation worksheet and scope draft; use a reviewed contract.

tools.name: RateFloor
tools.headline: Free Freelance Minimum Hourly Rate Calculator
tools.description: Calculate a sustainable hourly-rate floor with overhead, tax reserve, vacation and billable utilization, plus project quote scenarios.
tools.best_for: Independent professionals pricing projects without assuming all working hours are billable.
howto: Set desired take-home income and estimated business overhead.
Adjust illustrative tax reserve, vacation weeks and billable utilization.
Compare rate floors and export a scenario for your own pricing decision.
tools.limitations: Not tax, accounting or financial advice. No tax rules or market prices are computed.
tools.faq_question: Is the result the market price I should charge?
tools.faq_answer: No. It estimates your personal financial floor. Market demand and your skills may support different prices.

tools.name: CleanBid

tools.description: Quote cleaning jobs by selected areas and estimated labor hours, with supplies, overhead, profit margin and monthly recurrence.

tools.best_for: Small cleaning companies quoting a partial-home or small-office job without using square footage alone.
howto: List only the rooms or tasks included in the cleaning scope.
Enter crew labor hours, loaded wages, supplies, overhead and desired margin.
Print a per-visit and recurring monthly bid or export the task estimate.
tools.limitations: Labor hours are editable guesses; no site inspection, wage compliance, tax or insurance verification is provided.
tools.faq_question: Can I quote only a kitchen and two bathrooms?
tools.faq_answer: Yes. Remove unneeded areas and estimate only the labor required for the requested tasks.

tools.name: TileAudit

Print or copy a transparent quote comparison before agreeing on the billing basis.
tools.limitations: This is not a layout simulator or a pricing standard; cut patterns and contract terms can change real costs.
tools.faq_question: Should labor be charged on tile waste?
tools.faq_answer: This tool shows the arithmetic difference only. Labor billing depends on the written quote and the work performed.

tools.name: DilutionDeck
tools.headline: Cleaning Concentrate Dilution Ratio Calculator for Spray Bottles
tools.description: Convert manufacturer-approved product-to-water ratios into bottle quantities and estimate cost per fill.
tools.best_for: Professional cleaners and car detailers transferring labeled concentrate into smaller spray bottles.
howto: Read the exact product label and enter product parts and water parts.
Choose your bottle volume and unit, then calculate concentrate and water quantities.
Print or copy the mixing instructions after checking the manufacturer safety data.
tools.limitations: Not a chemical compatibility or disinfection effectiveness tool. Do not mix different chemicals; use only label-approved ratios.
tools.faq_question: Is 1:10 the same as 10% concentrate?
tools.faq_answer: No. One part product to ten parts water is one of eleven total parts, about 9.09% concentrate.

tools.name: PrintFit
tools.headline: Photo Print Resolution & Aspect Ratio Crop Checker
tools.description: Load a local photo, check effective print PPI after cropping and export a print-ratio JPEG without uploading.
keywords: pixels per inch after cropping photo
tools.best_for: Photographers preparing print-ready image crops while avoiding unexpected low-resolution results.
howto: Choose a JPEG, PNG or WebP photo stored on your device.
Enter the intended print dimensions and target PPI; inspect retained pixels.
Download the center-cropped JPEG or adjust your print aspect ratio.
tools.limitations: A center crop can remove important subjects; does not upscale, color-proof or add lab-specific bleed.
tools.faq_question: Does changing JPEG DPI metadata improve image detail?
tools.faq_answer: No. Effective print sharpness depends primarily on the source pixel dimensions, crop and physical print size.

tools.name: ProrateClear

tools.limitations: Not legal advice; does not determine whether proration is legally required or override a signed lease.
tools.faq_question: Which proration method is legally required?
tools.faq_answer: It depends on the lease and applicable law. This calculator compares arithmetic, not legal entitlement.
